title: Check file types inside a zip archive
summary: Use the `file` command with the `-z` flag to look inside a compressed zip file and determine the types of the files contained within it, without extracting them.

steps.explain: Run the `file` command with the `-z` (or `--uncompress`) flag followed by the path to the zip file. It will list the file types of the contents inside the archive.

placeholders.name: ZIP_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the zip archive you want to inspect.

steps.expect: Output listing the file types of the files inside the zip archive.
